newsitem.title: GREECE: ICC TO DECIDE ON IRAQ'S LIABILITY TO GREEK PYRKAL.
newsitem.headline: ICC TO DECIDE ON IRAQ'S LIABILITY TO GREEK PYRKAL.

text.p: Iraq has made a preliminary agreement with the Greek state and the Powder and Cartridge Company (PYRKAL) to take care of its $ 53 million liability, Pyrkal officials told Reuters on Monday.
"The liability was incurred when Iraq bought amunition from Pyrkal in 1985," said PYRKAL's managing director Mihalis Nikolaidis.
Pyrkal has made an appeal to the international referee court (ICC) to collect its money, Nikolaidis said.
But Iraq recently came to a preliminary agreement with Pyrkal, resigning from all rights to appeal and agreeing to pay back the outstanding amount, he added.
Pyrkal will submit to ICC the necessary documents which prove that Iraq has officially undertaken the responsibility to repay the $53 million, after the embargo on Baghdad is lifted, Nikolaidis said.
Iraq also proposed to start the repayment in kind, namely by providing crude oil and its derivatives and then go on to provide the Greek state with the remaining amount in cash.
"This proposal is still under consideration and we expect ICC's ruling to determine the course of events," he added. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
